name: List buckets
hint: Discover available buckets to identify potential targets.

name: Bucket policy scan
hint: Inspect bucket policy for misconfigurations that allow unauthorized access.

name: Download object
hint: Attempt to download an object if it's publicly accessible.

name: Recursive list
hint: Enumerate all objects in the bucket to find sensitive files.

name: Check object ACL
hint: Verify if the object ACL allows public read access.

name: Simulate HEAD request
hint: Check if the object is accessible via HTTP without authentication.

name: Bucket versioning check
hint: See if versioning is enabled, which might expose old versions.

name: Public URL access
hint: Directly access the object via its public URL if available.

name: Bucket tags inspection
hint: Check bucket tags for metadata that might reveal sensitive info.

name: Object metadata
hint: Retrieve object metadata without downloading the full content.

name: Block public access
hint: Prevent new public ACLs and block public policies to secure the bucket.

name: Revoke public ACL
hint: Change the object's ACL to private to stop unauthorized access.
example: aws s3api put-object-acl --bucket open-lab-public --key reports/report_001.txt --acl private

name: Enable bucket logging
hint: Enable access logging to monitor and detect suspicious activities.

name: Set bucket policy
hint: Apply a restrictive bucket policy to deny unauthorized access.

name: Delete public objects
hint: Remove publicly accessible objects to prevent data exposure.

name: Enable MFA delete
hint: Require MFA for delete operations to prevent accidental or malicious deletions.

name: Monitor access logs
hint: Review access logs to identify patterns of unauthorized access.

name: Rotate credentials
hint: Generate new access keys and revoke old ones to mitigate leaked credentials.

name: Set up alerts
pattern: aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm --alarm-name S3Access --alarm-description 'Alert on high S3 access' --metric-name NumberOfObjects --namespace AWS/S3 --statistic Sum --period 300 --threshold 100 --comparison-operator GreaterThanThreshold
hint: Create CloudWatch alarms to notify on unusual S3 activity.
example: aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm --alarm-name S3Access --alarm-description 'Alert on high S3 access' --metric-name NumberOfObjects --namespace AWS/S3 --statistic Sum --period 300 --threshold 100 --comparison-operator GreaterThanThreshold

name: Encrypt objects
pattern: aws s3 cp s3://{bucket}/{key} s3://{bucket}/{key} --sse AES256
hint: Apply server-side encryption to protect data at rest.
